title: Contradiction Reconstruction
observations: Reviewer reconstructed current authoritative behavior directly from contradictory raw evidence without a proposer conclusion.
Reviewer preferred current implementation/design/QA over historical and lower-authority evidence.
No unresolved conflict was invented where current authoritative sources were consistent.
Recurring evidence-precision issue remains possible around coarse classification of historical e2/e3 in the weighment-loop case, but no material outcome changed.
qualification_boundary: Behavioral manual bounded pass only. Does not by itself qualify the full review system or authorize PR11 promotion.
